title: The 10 Best 2-Slice Toasters
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for 2-slice toasters, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at 2-slice toasters using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Breville BTA720XL Die-Cast 2-Slice Smart Toaster
products.blurb: Key specs: Thermostatic (Element IQ) shade control, 1.5-inch wide slots, Lift-and-look mid-cycle inspection.
strengths: Same thermostatic browning consistency as the 4-slice BTA840XL, just in a smaller footprint
1.5-inch slots are the widest of any 2-slice toasterhere, handling bagels without compression
Lift-and-look avoids resetting the cycle when checking progress
Die-cast housing feels noticeably more solid than the stamped-metal budget models
limitations: The most expensive 2-slice toaster in this roundup by a wide margin
1-year warranty is shorter than the Cuisinart CPT-320's 3-year coverage
Die-cast finish shows fingerprints and needs regular wiping
features: 6-shade settings plus bagel and frozen modes

products.name: Cuisinart CPT-122 2-Slice Compact Toaster
products.blurb: Key specs: Compact footprint under 8 inches wide, 6-setting shade dial, Slide-out crumb tray.
strengths: Cuisinart's shading consistency at roughly half the price of premium models
Compact 8-inch footprint fits tight counters and small apartments
Slide-out crumb tray empties without disassembling the toaster
3-year warranty, standard across the Cuisinart lineup
limitations: Slots are around 1.1 inches wide, squeezes thick artisan bread
No lift-and-look; canceling mid-cycle resets the toast
Plastic housing runs warmer to the touch than metal-bodied models

products.name: Black+Decker T2707S 2-Slice Extra-Wide
products.blurb: Key specs: Extra-wide 1.5-inch slots, Toast boost lever raises small items for easier removal, 6-shade browning dial.
strengths: Toast boost lever raises short slices high enough to grab without tongs
Simple mechanical dial is easy to use and rarely needs recalibrating
limitations: Shade consistency varies more between a cold and warm toaster than on timer-compensated models
Housing is stamped metal and plastic, not die-cast, noticeably lighter and less rigid
Crumb tray is small and needs frequent emptying with regular use
features: Toast boost lever raises small items for easier removal

products.name: Smeg TSF01 2-Slice Toaster
products.blurb: Key specs: Available in 16 exterior colors, 1.4-inch wide slots, 9 shade settings.
strengths: The most visually distinctive toaster in this category, with 16 color options to match kitchen decor
9-position shade dial gives finer browning control than the typical 6-setting toaster
Auto-centering guides keep uneven or oddly shaped slices positioned against the elements
Build quality feels premium, solid door latch, weighted base, minimal wobble
limitations: Priced at a premium mainly for the design; browning performance is good but not class-leading
1.4-inch slots are slightly narrower than the Breville's 1.5-inch, so the largest bagels compress a bit
Limited color availability at any given time, popular colors go out of stock

products.name: Oster 2-Slice Toaster with Extra Wide Slots
products.blurb: Key specs: Extra-wide 1.5-inch slots, Stainless steel exterior, 6-shade settings.
strengths: 1.5-inch slots at a budget price, wide enough for bagels and thick bread without forcing
Stainless exterior looks and wipes cleaner than the plastic-bodied competitors at this price
Extra-lift lever raises short slices high enough to remove without touching the hot housing
limitations: Shade dial has visible gaps between settings, fine adjustment (3 vs 3.5) is not really possible
No lift-and-look; checking toast mid-cycle means canceling and restarting
Exterior runs hotter to the touch than die-cast models during back-to-back cycles

products.name: Dash Clear View 2-Slice Toaster
products.blurb: Key specs: Clear side windows to watch toast browning, 1.1-inch slots, 6-shade settings.
strengths: The clear windows genuinely let you watch browning progress without lifting the lever, useful for calibrating a new shade setting
Compact 7-inch footprint is one of the smallest 2-slice toasters available
Simple to clean, no crevices around the viewing windows to trap crumbs
limitations: 1.1-inch slots are narrow, thick artisan bread and large bagels compress noticeably
Plastic housing feels less substantial than metal-bodied competitors
The viewing windows fog slightly with steam on longer cycles, reducing visibility right when it matters most
features: Clear side windows to watch toast browning

products.name: Cuisinart CPT-320 2-Slice Compact Toaster
products.blurb: Key specs: 1.25-inch wide slots, Brushed stainless housing, 6-shade settings with bagel and defrost modes.
strengths: 1.25-inch slots handle most bagels and thick sandwich bread without excessive compression
Compact stainless housing fits small counters while looking more upscale than plastic budget models
3-year warranty matches the CPT-122 and beats every non-Cuisinart budget option here
limitations: Costs more than the CPT-122 for a moderate slot-width upgrade, a marginal gain for some households
Timer-based control, not thermostatic, first cold cycle runs slightly lighter
No lift-and-look feature
features: 6-shade settings with bagel and defrost modes

products.name: KitchenAid KMT2116 2-Slice Long Slot Toaster
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-inch long slots for baguette and sandwich-loaf slices, 1.3-inch slot width, 5 toast settings plus bagel, reheat, and defrost.
strengths: The only 2-slice toaster in this roundup with true 12-inch long slots, fitting baguette slices standard toasters can't
Die-cast housing feels substantially more solid than the stamped-metal budget competitors
Color options let it match a KitchenAid stand mixer or other small appliances
5-setting dial is simple and reliable, with dedicated bagel and reheat buttons
limitations: Fewer reviews (2,200) than most toasters in this list, a smaller sample to judge long-term reliability
Priced closer to the Breville than to the mid-range Cuisinart options, a premium mainly for slot length
1.3-inch width is adequate but not as wide as the Breville's 1.5 inches for very thick bread
features: 12-inch long slots for baguette and sandwich-loaf slices
5 toast settings plus bagel, reheat, and defrost
Available in matching KitchenAid stand mixer colors

products.name: Hamilton Beach 22633G 2-Slice Toaster
products.blurb: Key specs: 1.5-inch wide slots, Toast boost lever, 6-shade settings.
strengths: 1.5-inch slots match the Breville's slot width at a fraction of the price
Toast boost lever lifts short items high enough to remove safely
Straightforward mechanical controls with no software or display to fail
limitations: Timer-based heating produces a noticeably lighter first slice on a cold toaster
Plastic housing runs warm during back-to-back cycles
1-year warranty is short compared to the Cuisinart models' 3-year coverage

products.name: BELLA 2-Slice Toaster
products.blurb: Key specs: 1.0-inch slots, 6-shade dial, Removable crumb tray.
strengths: Compact footprint fits the tightest counters and dorm-size kitchens
Basic functions (toast, cancel, reheat) work reliably for standard sandwich bread
Simple dial control with no components likely to fail beyond the heating element
limitations: 1.0-inch slots are too narrow for bagels or thick artisan bread without heavy compression
Browning is noticeably less even at the top and bottom edges than mid-range models
Lightweight plastic housing can shift on the counter during use

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
